result_summary.title: Gaps in Analytics Dashboard audit logs due to clock sync
result_summary.description: We have identified missing entries in the audit logs for the Analytics Dashboard in our ANZ production environment. This affects about 13 users. We think it's a clock/time synchronization issue on the server side, causing timestamps to drift and logs to be discarded or misordered during the aggregation process. Please verify the time sync status on the logging infrastructure.
